## 冷首帧归因（INSTR，第五轮）

INSTR（2026-11-11，副本候选实现）：wheel/grid带打点冷首帧中位数38.412→27.075ms、24.214→12.993ms，精确文字宽度缓存将首帧TextPainter.layout次数276→63、128→22；随机/多语言/emoji/lineClamp等价。减DEVFIN历史空白2.883ms后的增量24.192/10.110ms，新预算26.612/11.121ms，仍未达到原4ms目标，三轮波动大。CPU采用/proc累计节拍差，UI与平台合并标为UI+platform；wheel完整链路仅2/5，不能给三轮中位数；其余场景逐轮数值和有效性见本轮报告，lotto仅搅拌阶段。库改动以补丁交付，未覆盖并行共享lib，待主会话合并。

以上逐阶段去重表、每个事件起止、三轮原值、CPU与限制见[第五轮完整归因报告](../tool/bench/results/pending2/REPORT.md)及[attribution.json](../tool/bench/results/pending2/attribution.json)。首帧中位数代表轮中，wheel文字32.138→15.709ms（Dart Frame占81.69%→51.76%），grid文字16.345→4.774ms（63.12%→33.40%）；布局/文字/录制为嵌套片段，不直接相加。已定位重复整形、已在副本修复并观测改善；未打点区间及异步图片解码仍无法判定。

README.md: INSTR (2026-11-11, isolated candidate): exact text-width caching reduced cold wheel/grid TextPainter.layout calls from 276/128 to 63/22. Instrumented build-duration medians changed from 38.412/24.214 ms to 27.075/12.993 ms. Increments over the historical DEVFIN blank (2.883 ms) are 24.192/10.110 ms; calibrated increment budgets are 26.612/11.121 ms. Both still miss the original 4 ms target and the three-round spread is large. CPU uses /proc tick deltas and actual host intervals; UI and platform are reported together. Wheel has only 2/5 complete driver runs, so no three-run median; lotto CPU covers mixing only. Library changes are delivered as patches for the shared workspace, pending merge. See the [INSTR report](https://github.com/icodejoo/dart-labs/blob/main/luckdraw/tool/bench/results/pending2/REPORT.md). The DEVFIN/MET2 text below remains historical and does not establish complete performance compliance.
